claim: In a single-past model, a time traveller cannot make the past different but may participate in the events that made it so.
notes: Substantive revision date recorded. Used as a philosophical model for fictional consistency, not as proof that physical backwards time travel exists.

claim: The proposed self-consistency principle requires local events in a closed-timelike-curve model to fit a globally consistent solution.
publisher: Physical Review D / American Physical Society
notes: Primary theoretical physics paper archived by Caltech; DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.42.1915. Its conditional model does not establish that practical time travel is physically achievable.

claim: Immersive Portals allows players to see through portals and cross them seamlessly; it supports portals connecting dimensions.
notes: Project page. Apache-2.0 licence. Establishes the base rendering and traversal capability, not compatibility with the other candidate mods.

claim: The command /portal set_portal_destination <dimension> <x> <y> <z> assigns an exact destination dimension and position; connected portal entities can be removed to leave a one-way portal.
notes: Used for the proposed same-coordinate echo chain. Command behaviour still requires an in-build test.

claim: Multiworld can create and teleport to multiple worlds; /mw create accepts generator and seed arguments, and portals may target a world or exact coordinates.
notes: Repository README documents /mw create myLovelyWorld NORMAL -g=FLAT -s=1234 and exact-coordinate portal destinations. LGPL-3.0 licence.

claim: Multiworld 1.12 is a Fabric beta release listing Minecraft 1.20.1 compatibility.
notes: Candidate release only. Required libraries and interoperability with Immersive Portals must be resolved and tested in the clean profile.

claim: Dimensional Weather exists to permit dimension-specific weather conditions rather than sharing overworld weather state.
notes: MIT-licensed lightweight fix for dimension-specific weather. Does not itself prove portal-view rendering.

claim: Dimensional Weather 1.1-1.20.1 supports Minecraft 1.20.1 on Fabric and Quilt.
notes: Candidate Fabric release. Client-and-server environment. Exact dependency versions must be resolved during installation.

claim: A copied Minecraft Java Edition seed can be used to create new worlds from the same base map.
notes: Supports using one seed as the common geographic base. Exact matching still assumes the same version, generator and generation-affecting configuration.

claim: Mojang describes seeds as numbers Minecraft uses to reliably generate a world, producing the same world when the same seed is reused.
notes: Used only for the deterministic base-world principle. Production will retain a clean master because generation configuration can alter results.

claim: Immersive Portals 5.2.0 is listed as a release for Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.
notes: Candidate version for the proof of concept. The release page notes updated Sodium and Iris compatibility; the complete production stack remains untested.
